# Merritt's Auto Recycling

> Same-day cash for junk cars in the Twin Cities — we'll tow your junk car away for free, paid in cash on the spot.

Merritt's Auto Recycling is a family-owned auto recycler in Brooklyn Center, Minnesota, founded in 1988 by Brad Emholtz. We buy junk, salvage, wrecked, and unwanted vehicles across the Twin Cities metro and outer suburbs — running or not, with or without title. Same-day pickup, we'll tow your junk car away for free, cash paid on the spot. Call **763-533-2775** or text **763-438-2116** for an instant quote.

## Contact

- **Phone:** 763-533-2775 (calls)
- **Text:** 763-438-2116
- **Email:** merrittsautorecycling@gmail.com
- **Address:** 3106 68th Ave N, Brooklyn Center, MN 55429
- **Hours:** Open Daily 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- **Website:** https://merritts-auto-recycling.com/

- Junk Cars
- Used Cars

- Pickup Trucks

- Vehicles Without Titles

## Why sellers choose us

- **Same-Day Cash Payment** — Cash paid on the spot at pickup — no waiting for checks to clear.
- **Free Junk Car Pickup** — We'll tow your junk car away for free throughout our service area when we buy it — no tow fee deducted from your cash.
- **Instant Quote** — Call 763-533-2775 or text 763-438-2116 for an immediate price quote — no quote forms or callback delays.
- **No Title Required (often)** — We can often purchase vehicles without keys or titles — call to confirm for your situation.
- **Environmental Recycling** — Vehicles we cannot resell are recycled per Minnesota Pollution Control Agency standards.
- **Trusted Since 1988** — Family-owned and operated by Brad Emholtz with over 17 years of trusted auto recycling service.

## Service area

We serve the entire Twin Cities metro and outer suburbs, covering 8 counties: Hennepin County, MN, Anoka County, MN, Sherburne County, MN, Wright County, MN, Mille Lacs County, MN, Stearns County, MN, Benton County, MN, Ramsey County, MN.

## Guides & articles

- [How Much Is My Junk Car Worth in Minnesota in 2026?](https://merritts-auto-recycling.com/blog/how-much-is-my-junk-car-worth-minnesota-2026) — A clear, no-fluff guide to what a junk car is actually worth in Minnesota right now, with a price range table by vehicle type, the five factors that move the offer up or down, and how scrap-metal pricing translates into the cash in your hand.
- [Minnesota Junk Car Title Requirements (and What to Do If You've Lost Yours)](https://merritts-auto-recycling.com/blog/minnesota-junk-car-title-requirements) — The complete rundown on title requirements when junking a car in Minnesota — duplicate titles, bonded titles, derelict-vehicle exemptions, and the specific paperwork we need at pickup.
- [Your Car's Scrap Value by Weight: A 2026 Guide for Minnesota Sellers](https://merritts-auto-recycling.com/blog/scrap-value-by-weight-minnesota-guide) — A practical, math-backed look at how Minnesota junk yards turn scrap metal weight into a cash offer — including catalytic converter pricing, current per-ton rates, and how to estimate your own vehicle's weight class.
- [Do You Need to Remove License Plates Before Junking a Car in Minnesota?](https://merritts-auto-recycling.com/blog/mn-license-plates-before-junking) — What every Minnesota seller needs to know about license plate removal, registration cancellation, transfer-of-ownership forms, and avoiding any post-sale liability when junking a vehicle.
- [How Auto Recycling Reduces Landfill Waste in the Twin Cities](https://merritts-auto-recycling.com/blog/auto-recycling-environmental-impact-twin-cities) — A look at what actually happens to a junk car after it leaves your driveway — the metals reclaimed, the fluids captured, the parts resold — and why selling to a licensed recycler beats letting the vehicle rot.
- [Sell a Running Junk Car vs. a Non-Running Junk Car: Pricing Differences](https://merritts-auto-recycling.com/blog/running-vs-non-running-junk-car-prices) — When the engine still turns over, your car has resale-parts value — sometimes 2–3× the scrap price. This guide walks through the offer differences and the (rare) cases where pre-sale repairs pay off.
- [Junk Car Pickup vs. Trade-In vs. Private Sale: Which Gets You the Most Cash?](https://merritts-auto-recycling.com/blog/junk-vs-tradein-vs-private-sale) — A frank comparison of the three exit paths for an old vehicle — junk yard, trade-in, private sale — based on payout, time-to-cash, total effort, and the lemon-law / lemon-buyer risk of each route.
- [What Happens to Your Car After We Pick It Up at Merritt's](https://merritts-auto-recycling.com/blog/what-happens-to-car-after-pickup) — An end-to-end walkthrough of what happens after Brad's team rolls up to your driveway — the inspection, the cash handoff, the title transfer, the parts triage, the fluid capture, and the final recycling steps.
- [Top 10 Most-Junked Cars in Minnesota by Model Year](https://merritts-auto-recycling.com/blog/top-10-most-junked-cars-minnesota) — Pulled from 37 years of Merritt's pickup data: the ten vehicle lines that show up at the yard more than any other, what fails first on each, and what we typically pay.
- [Free Junk Car Removal in Minneapolis, MN: How It Works](https://merritts-auto-recycling.com/blog/free-junk-car-removal-minneapolis-mn) — Exactly how free junk car removal works for Minneapolis residents — what you need on hand, how the price gets quoted, where the truck shows up, and how the cash changes hands.
